At 572 kilometers, the Lilies‘ visit to the Olympic Stadium will be the longest away game of the season. Our last trip to Hertha in particular is certainly still in the minds of some 98er fans; on the 33rd matchday of the 2015/16 season, SVD achieved a 2-1 away win and thus secured their place in the Bundesliga.
